entries.b14a74b60c1a78f3: Management policies cite coexistence with society and protection of the global environment, contribution to society through high value-added products, continuous improvement and innovation in technology, and the creation of a vibrant company that respects the individuality of employees. The 11th Management Plan, 'NIPPON KINZOKU 2030' (a 10-year plan), sets as its vision 'a Multi & Hybrid Material company that co-creates new value that is kind to people and the Earth.' Using 'Multi & Hybrid Material,' 'near net shape' and 'near net performance' as keywords, it aims to master rolling and processing technologies and transform the business structure, with new technologies and new products as the main drivers. The 5 basic policies are: deepening relationships, strengthening manufacturing capabilities, commercializing next-generation growth products, developing products with unique technologies with a view to the future, and building a vibrant workplace and strengthening human resources.
